newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Investors give Belgian Recticel a ride.
newsitem.headline: Investors give Belgian Recticel a ride.

text.p: Ordinary shares in Belgian industrial foam maker Recticel sharply narrowed their discount to preferred-dividend shares on Friday, although traders were at a loss to explain why.
By late afternoon in Brussels, the ordinary shares were up 7.44 percent at 462 francs, 42 francs below those offering preferred dividends, which were also higher.

Recticel said at its annual press conference in March its accumulated unpaid preferred dividends amounted to 152 francs. By pushing the ordinary shares so close to the preferred shares, the market appears to doubt these dividends will ever be repaid.
Recticel said in March the obligation to pay the accumulated unpaid dividends falls at the end of 1998.
